topic: Cross-bilateral normal-stopping crease filter vs depth-only bilateral 90-degree corner bleed rig
topic_zh: 交叉双边法线截断门控（Normal-Stopping Filter）对比仅深度双边滤波 90° 墙角黑边晕染
scope: Deterministic Sloan/Kopf/SVGF cross-bilateral normal-stopping spatial filtering (w_N(p, q) = max(0, N_p . N_q)^32) versus naive depth-only bilateral filtering (Delta_z = 0 -> w_z = 1) and 64-tap spherical normal-angle kernel integration across 17 pixel stations (d in [-8px, +8px]) spanning a 90-degree continuous-depth wall-floor crease. No neural GI denoiser execution.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 crease pixel stations preserve crisp 90-degree wall-floor irradiance separation

good_fit: Spatial denoising and upsampling of SSGI, GTAO, Ray-Traced Diffuse GI, and SVGF/NRD passes in UE5, Unity, and Three.js
Preventing dark floor or shadow-side irradiance from bleeding across 90° corners where depth Δz = 0m is continuous
Combining normal dot-product gating max(0, N_p·N_q)^32 with plane-distance depth weights |N_p·(P_q − P_p)|
Maintaining crisp architectural wall-ceiling-floor creases and hard-surface mechanical bevels
not_for: High-frequency normal-mapped bumpy walls where N_p should be the geometric vertex normal rather than the perturbed normal-map normal
Pure skybox or volumetric fog layers that have no surface normal vector N
Neural autoencoder post-process denoisers (OIDN / OptiX AI Denoiser)
